The '''Talinn district''' was a district located on the [[planet]] [[Taris]]. After the [[Devastation of Taris]], the planet was left a wasteland<ref name="Empire's End" /> by [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''Aftermath: Empire's End'' features the [[Battle of Jakku]], an event that ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[5 ABY]].</ref> including the Talinn district, where many buildings were wrecked and crashed starships littered the ground. The uncle of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Mercurial Swift]] lived in the old Talinn district in 5 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].<ref name="Empire's End" />
